title: CV — Adolfo S. Rey B.
metaDescription: Curriculum vitae of Adolfo S. Rey B. — economist and lawyer, MA Economics candidate at Universidad de los Andes.
heading: Curriculum Vitae
teachingSummary: Teaching Fellow (profesor complementario), Department of Economics, Universidad de los Andes, 2024–present. Undergraduate Teaching Assistant, 2019–2023.
Advanced theory and core sequence courses, including Game Theory, Microeconomics III, Industrial Organization and Macroeconomics.
researchSummary: Banking intermediation, credit regulation, monetary policy transmission and financial networks in emerging economies. Applied research for the Ministry of Health of El Salvador under a World Bank–funded project.
identityLine: Bogotá, Colombia · Colombian and U.S. citizen · Authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
